annotation.title_clean: Western Balkans Digital Economy and Society Index 2024 Report
annotation.title_en: Western Balkans Digital Economy and Society Index 2024 Report
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Tintor, V.; Jovanović, N.; Bugarski, M.; Regional Cooperation Council
annotation.summary_en: Regional Cooperation Council report benchmarking the six Western Balkan economies against the EU Digital Economy and Society Index across digital skills, infrastructure, business digitalisation and public services. AI appears only as a business-adoption indicator (5% of enterprises in one economy). The metadata title (Albania's AI Minister) does not match the text. No embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Only 32% of WB6 people have basic digital skills versus 56% in the EU.
WB6 aligns DESI methodology with the EU to allow direct comparison.
Alignment with EU digital acquis is a priority under the Growth Plan and Common Regional Market 2025-2028.
Business adoption of AI is low (about 5% of enterprises in one economy).
Persistent data gaps hinder full DESI alignment.
